name: Akishino no Furutsugu
source:
"If it's a beautiful princess's wish then there is no way I could refuse."
Publicly he is the chief of security, in private an exorcist. His line of work often involves charming women in order to coax information from them, thus making him into a lady killer with an alluring air about him.
